summary: 高中阶段要求熟练运用完成进行时、过去将来时、过去完成时等复杂时态，并能在语篇中根据上下文选择正确时态和语态。

rules.title: 过去完成时：had + 过去分词
rules.detail: 表示「过去的过去」——过去的某个时间或动作之前已经完成的动作。常与 by the time、before、when 连用。

examples.en: By the time he arrived, the train had already left.
examples.zh: 他到达时，火车已经开走了。

examples.en: She had learned English for five years before she went abroad.
examples.zh: 出国之前她已经学了五年英语。

rules.title: 过去将来时：would / was going to + 动词原形
rules.detail: 站在过去看将来，常用于宾语从句中：He said he would come the next day.

examples.en: They said they would visit us the following week.
examples.zh: 他们说下周会来看我们。

examples.en: I didn't know you were going to leave so soon.
examples.zh: 我不知道你这么快就要走。

rules.title: 现在完成进行时：have/has been doing
rules.detail: 强调动作从过去持续到现在，且可能继续下去，常与 all day、for hours 连用，突出「一直在做」。

examples.en: It has been raining since morning.
examples.zh: 从早上开始一直在下雨。

examples.en: I have been waiting for you for two hours.
examples.zh: 我已经等了你两个小时了。

signals: by the end of last...（过去完成）
pitfalls: by the end of last year 用现在完成：❌ has finished → ✓ had finished
过去完成时滥用：没有「过去的过去」参照点就不用 had done
瞬间动词的完成进行：❌ He has been dying... → die 不能用完成进行

questions.stem: By the end of last month, they ___ over 2,000 words.
questions.explain: by the end of last month 表示到过去某时为止，用过去完成时 had learned。

questions.stem: She told me that she ___ the book twice before she was fifteen.
questions.explain: 「读」发生在 was fifteen（过去）之前，是「过去的过去」，用过去完成时。

questions.stem: — Why are your hands so dirty? — I ___ the car for the whole morning.
questions.explain: for the whole morning + 手现在脏（结果延续），强调「一直在修」，用现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: The plan ___ at the meeting tomorrow afternoon.
questions.explain: plan 是「被讨论」，tomorrow 是将来，用将来时被动 will be discussed。

questions.stem: When I got to the cinema, the film ___ (be) on for ten minutes.
questions.explain: got to 是过去，电影「已经开始十分钟」发生在它之前，用过去完成时 had been。

questions.stem: He said that great changes ___ (take) place in his hometown in the past few years.
questions.explain: in the past few years 常配完成时；主句 said 是过去时，从句用过去完成时 had taken。

questions.stem: When she rushed into the station, the train has left.
questions.explain: 火车开走发生在「她冲进车站」之前，是过去的过去，用 had left。

questions.stem: 到上周为止，我们已经完成了这个项目。（翻译整句）
answer: we had finished the project by last week.
we had completed the project by last week.
questions.explain: by last week 提示到过去某时为止，用过去完成时 had finished。

questions.stem: 她说她第二天要动身去巴黎。（翻译整句，leave for）
answer: she said that she would leave for paris the next day.
she said she would leave for paris the next day.
questions.explain: 主句 said 过去时，从句用过去将来时 would leave；the next day 是过去的「第二天」。
